subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: When an exec-like or read-only tool error leaves a channel turn with zero user-visible payloads, should OpenClaw surface a warning/fallback despite the current exec-like suppression and `lastToolError` fallback guard?
rationale: The source-level fix is small, but the behavior changes a safety boundary between quiet recoverable failures, noisy channel warnings, and fail-closed protection against replaying side-effectful tools.

options.title: Define A Narrow Warning/Fallback Contract
options.body: Allow warnings or incomplete-turn fallback only when no user-facing reply was delivered and replay metadata says the attempt is safe or already terminal.

options.title: Split Remaining Work Across Canonicals
options.body: Route placeholder-only work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 and replay-unsafe recovery to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657, leaving this composite issue as coordination only.

options.title: Keep Existing Fail-Quiet Policy
options.body: Accept that exec-like non-detailed failures and `lastToolError` zero-payload turns can remain silent unless a separate delivered error path exists.

recommendation.title: Define A Narrow Warning/Fallback Contract
recommendation.body: Allow warnings or incomplete-turn fallback only when no user-facing reply was delivered and replay metadata says the attempt is safe or already terminal.
